resources.string: Lets your agents read and operate the apps you authorise

Lets AI Control Center agents read the screen of the apps you authorise in Tools › Screen control and tap, type and scroll there, one action at a time. Consequential actions (send, buy, delete…) wait for your approval. A banner shows while an agent operates, with a Stop button. Agents never operate Android settings, installers, permission screens, the lock screen, this app, password fields or views apps mark as sensitive.
Stop the agents operating the screen
